trials.claim: Lifetime access to Watermarkup on Pro Plan
trials.claimQuote:
### Pro Plan: $15 (was $49)
- Lifetime access to Watermarkup
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future Pro Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The vendor states Pro access is available whenever you want for a one-time fee, supporting lifetime access; the 5-month limit in E1 concerns bundled Mr.Webtool features, not Watermarkup itself.

exhibits.quote: When you purhase a Watermarkup Pro account directly from our website, you can have access to Pro features of Mr.Webtool for 5 months for free.
exhibits.argument: The quote shows bundled Pro access expires after 5 months, which limits the lifetime scope.

exhibits.quote: You can access our watermark application whenever you want. Only One-time fee.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states Pro gives ongoing access for a one-time fee, supporting lifetime access.

trials.claimQuote:
- Watermark 150 - 200 photos in minutes
- Unlimited fonts and photos
- Not reducing your image quality
- Watermark multiple photos at the same time
trials.reasoning: The vendor explicitly promises watermarking unlimited photos at the same time; the one-file limit in E2 applies to the free version, not Pro, and one freezing report does not establish a product limit.

exhibits.quote: The free version will only allow you to add watermarks to one image file at the same time.
exhibits.argument: The quote shows watermarking is limited to one file at a time, contradicting unlimited photos.

exhibits.quote: It never got much past the uploading of a few pics before it freezes up and the page became unresponsive.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports freezing after a few pics, undermining unlimited photo handling.

exhibits.quote: Explore our font gallery and choose the best ones for your photos.
exhibits.argument: Vendor advertises a font gallery choice, supporting unlimited fonts.

exhibits.quote: Now you can enjoy watermarking unlimited photos at the same time.
exhibits.argument: Vendor explicitly promises unlimited photo watermarking at once.

trials.claimQuote:

trials.reasoning: The vendor promises 150-200 photos within a few minutes on Pro and a 5-star buyer confirms batch watermarking hundreds in minutes, outweighing one freezing report and an unspecified upload limit.

exhibits.quote: Limit on the number of photos per upload
exhibits.argument: The quote shows uploads are capped, undermining watermarking 150-200 photos in minutes.

exhibits.quote: It never got much past the uploading of a few pics before it freezes up and the page became unresponsive.
exhibits.argument: The buyer could not process more than a few pics, contradicting 150-200 photos in minutes.

exhibits.quote: With a pro account, you can reduce manual work and watermark 150 - 200 photos within a few minutes.
exhibits.argument: Vendor directly promises 150-200 photos watermarked within minutes on Pro.

exhibits.quote: The ability to batch watermark hundreds of photos in minutes is a game-changer for anyone who values their time.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms batch watermarking hundreds of photos in minutes works.

exhibits.quote: However, I was having issues with the blind watermaks. It was either not detected, or the text is not properly read in the decoding process.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports invisible watermarks fail to detect or decode, undermining protection.

exhibits.quote: We understand that you need to protect your images from theft.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states the app is for protecting images from theft.

exhibits.quote: Adjust fonts, size, color, background color and position of the watermark until you are satisfied.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes fully adjustable customizable watermarks.
